jobs.title: SAP IS-U ORT Lead – Billing & Payments
jobs.description:
**Role Description** 




 We are seeking a senior Operational Readiness Testing (ORT) Lead to support a major utility's SAP IS\-U billing and payments go\-live. This is a strategy\-level, PMO\-facing role. You will define and own the ORT approach — not simply execute a pre\-built test plan — and ensure business processes, systems and operational teams are fully ready for go\-live through testing, defect resolution and performance validation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and own the end\-to\-end ORT strategy, applying risk\-based testing principles to prioritize scope, scenarios and coverage
* Set clear ORT scope, objectives and exit criteria, and explain how ORT differs from SIT, UAT and regression testing to stakeholders and business sponsors
* Identify and manage ORT\-specific risks such as data readiness, environment stability, cutover dependencies and business sign\-off, and build mitigations into the strategy
* Coordinate and execute bill compare activities, validating calculated bills against expected results across rates, billing determinants and customer scenarios
* Manage mass runs for billing, invoicing and payment processing to confirm system stability, performance and production readiness
* Develop ORT scripts, scenarios and acceptance criteria aligned with business and regulatory requirements
* Partner with functional, technical and business teams to identify defects, track resolution and validate fixes through retesting
* Ensure readiness of downstream processes including bill print, payment posting, collections and customer communications
* Provide daily ORT status reporting, risk identification and mitigation recommendations to project leadership
* Work with business SMEs to validate operational procedures, job aids and training materials for cutover and post\-go\-live support
* Support mock cutover activities and validate end\-to\-end operational workflows



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* 10\+ years of IT/SAP experience, including 5\+ years in SAP IS\-U (preferred)
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP IS\-U Billing, Invoicing and Payments (FI\-CA)
* Demonstrated leadership of ORT, UAT or large\-scale testing cycles for utility implementations
* Proven ability to independently plan and lead a risk\-based ORT strategy for complex, multi\-workstream programs
* Deep understanding of billing determinants, rate structures and payment processing
* Experience executing or overseeing mass billing runs and bill comparison tools
* Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience taking at least one utility SAP IS\-U program through go\-live and hypercare
* Exposure to S/4HANA Utilities
* Experience with test management tools such as HP ALM/QC or JIRA

As an **SAP Joule \& Multi\-Agent Integration Engineer**, you will pioneer our agentic AI roadmap — designing, building, and securing cross\-platform agent networks that connect SAP's Joule ecosystem with ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms over open agent communication protocols. You will own the full lifecycle of agent development, from BTP provisioning through production A2A orchestration.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy pro\-code AI agents on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry/Kyma) using Joule Studio, LangGraph, or SAP Cloud SDK for AI — defining agent tools, orchestration logic, and backend integrations against S/4HANA OData APIs (Orders, Quotes, Contracts, Accounts) via BTP Destination Service
* Architect and implement end\-to\-end A2A communication between SAP Joule and the ServiceNow platform — exposing Joule agents as A2A\-compliant servers via SAP Agent Gateway, authoring Agent Cards, configuring JSON\-RPC endpoints, and registering External Agent Providers in ServiceNow AI Agent Studio over Google A2A protocol v0\.3\.0
* Design primary/secondary agent delegation patterns, async push notification flows, and timeout\-resilient pipelines across SAP and non\-SAP agent networks — ensuring agents reason, delegate, and recover reliably at enterprise scale
* Configure end\-to\-end authentication across agent boundaries using OAuth2, SAP IAS App2App trust, and BTP Cloud Identity Services — enforcing least\-privilege access, token governance, and audit\-ready agent call chains
* Own the full SAP BTP stack underpinning agent workloads — AI Core provisioning, SAP Build Process Automation entitlements, Cloud Foundry runtime, Destination Service, and SAP Agent Gateway configuration
* Instrument agent pipelines with structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting so failures are caught early, root\-caused quickly, and prevented systematically across multi\-hop agent calls

**Requirements**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on SAP BTP engineering experience, including Cloud Foundry, SAP Cloud Identity Services, and Destination Service configuration
* Proven experience building and deploying custom Joule agents in Joule Studio (pro\-code path) with tool definitions wired to SAP backend systems via OData or REST APIs
* Demonstrated production experience enabling Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) integration between SAP Joule and ServiceNow AI Agent Studio, including Agent Card authoring, External Agent Provider registration, credential aliasing, and A2A protocol handshake validation
* Strong command of agentic AI frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent) and multi\-agent orchestration patterns, including delegation, fallback, and async response handling
* Solid understanding of API security and authentication: OAuth 2\.0, mutual TLS, SAP IAS trust configurations, and BTP service bindings
* Familiarity with ServiceNow platform internals — Now Assist AI Agents, Integration Hub, Flow Designer, and Connection \& Credential Aliases
* Strong grasp of distributed systems design, API performance, and fault\-tolerance patterns relevant to multi\-agent pipelines
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex agent topology designs for both engineering and business audiences

**Nice to have**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) alongside A2A for tool and resource exposure across agent boundaries
* Exposure to SAP BRIM, SOM, or BTP Integration Suite (CPI) for SAP business process integration context
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Yokohama/Zurich release features for external agent interoperability
* SAP BTP or ServiceNow certifications (Certified Application Developer, Certified Implementation Specialist)
* CI/CD experience for BTP workloads using Cloud Foundry CLI, MTA deployment, or GitHub Actions pipelines

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)
